sweep.policy: read the task and the graph commit id, submit m_claim_cond conditioned on that commit id; on precondition_failure read again and resubmit, until it succeeds or reaches the cap; any other refusal, a task no longer open, or an unknown outcome ends the agent

interpretation: a cost of documented behaviour (any intervening commit invalidates a conditional claim, O-K3), not a defect
invariants_note: I1A is a sanity check here, not the purpose

expected.omnigraph: [unmeasured]; hypothesis [inference from O-K3]: wasted attempts grow with N

agent_connections.note: one HTTP/1.1 connection per agent; a read dropped by the server is its own history record and is sent again on a fresh connection; a dropped claim is an unknown outcome and is never resent
